priya: Following up on the postmortem action list 17999xx: we need to lock owners for runbook edits, add a compact triage checklist, and codify paging thresholds. Dropping owners here so RW-INC-5205 can be closed once PRs merge.

dan: I'll own the recurring-pattern notes + alert tweaks. Plan: add a Grafana rule for kv_miss spikes tied to deploy windows and a weekly report. ETA 2026-04-20.

jin: I'll take the triage checklist + `tools/incident_collect.sh`. Goal: one-page TL;DR, 6 commands, and an uploader. PR by Mon EOD.

marco: I'll handle the escalation matrix & exact PagerDuty service mapping. Also add an explicit "when to page" box. PR by Thu.

priya: Proposed paging thresholds: sustained p95 increase >10% for >8m OR error_rate >0.7% for >4m. Also propose auto-fallback after 10m if mitigations don't reduce p95 by 25%. Agree?

d an: Agree on thresholds. For the recurring-pattern work I'll surface incidents clustered by deploy time +/- 10m and expose a checkbox in the runbook: "If deploy within 10m -> check cache prewarm and consider rollback."

jin: Example quick-collect commands I'll add to the runbook (short & copy/paste):
```bash
# metrics snapshot (last 100 lines)
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 100
# model cache summary
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
# recent runtime logs (json lines)
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 500 -o cat --no-pager | jq -r '.message' | tail -n 500
# worker list
redwood-admin workers list --format json | jq '.[] | {id,status,variant,gpu_util}'
```
I'll annotate which fields to check (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, model_load_time_ms, gpu_util) and include the small incident collector script in infra/tools.

marco: Escalation snippet I'll add to the playbook: 
```text
1) Confirm impact metric (p95 / error_rate) and window.
2) If p95 > threshold -> PUT /admin/routing {"variant":"fallback"}.
3) If kv_miss_rate spike -> POST /admin/cache/prewarm {"prefixes":["popular:*"]}.
4) If no improvement after 10m -> page infra-sre; after 30m -> exec notify.
5) Post-mitigation: verify metrics stable for 20m before close.
```
I'll map each step to PD services and add rotation links.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-5205: "playbook - triage checklist, escalation mapping, recurring-pattern alerts". Assigned to jin, dan, marco. Due 2026-04-20.

priya: Final owners/dates: jin - triage checklist + incident_collect.sh (PR by Mon 2026-03-30); dan - recurring-pattern alerts + report (ETA 2026-04-20); marco - escalation matrix + PD mapping (PR by Thu 2026-04-02). We'll have a 20-min review Fri 09:00 to walk diffs.

jin: Starting the PR now, tagging @marco and @priya. Will include a short verification checklist showing what "good" looks like (p95 back to baseline, kv_hit_rate stable for 20m).

dan: I'll add the dashboard panel and a weekly job that emails the incident clusters to the oncall list.

marco: I'll include exact PagerDuty service names and a 1-line TL;DR at top of the playbook for on-call.

priya: Thanks team. If blockers crop up post PR ping here. Otherwise we mark RW-INC-5205 resolved after PRs merge and verification. :rocket:
